name: @mavis/codemode-host
description: Codemode sandbox host (W07 part B): runs out-of-context tool-call scripts on @earendil-works/pi-codemode — the npm dependency per plan §4 A5 («Codemode worker/inline/portable/remote и deterministic replay входят в слой целиком», plan :185). Nested tool calls go through the injected invoker (the ONE gateway executeTool), never around it; QuickJS is a capability sandbox parallel to the OS sandbox, not a replacement (U21); deterministic replay records and re-delivers call outcomes (replay safe/never, TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN distinct).
